description: One of your past Toast orders as a receipt: items with modifiers and price, subtotal, discounts, tax, tip, service charges, gift card applied, total (all dollars), payments (type, card brand, last 4), and delivery address/provider when it was delivered. Takes the restaurant and order GUIDs from toast_list_orders. Needs a toast.app sign-in in the browser running ContextMint Bridge.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact (default) returns the shaped result; "full" returns the Toast gateway's raw `data` object untouched.

name: toast_get_order
